pages.text: $(l)Mekanism$() is a large tech mod built around multiplying your ores: each processing tier adds machines and chemicals that turn one ore into more ingots, up to five.$(br2)It also brings its own alloys, reactors and antimatter, most made in custom machines no crafting recipe describes.

Mekanism's ores are mined and its alloys come from custom machines, so both are priced by hand. They span $(l)Tier 2$() to $(l)Tier 6$(), with one exception at the very top.$(br2)An $(l)antimatter pellet$() sits at $(l)Tier 8$(), one of only two Tier 8 materials MC3DPrint knows about. It needs an antimatter plant, which is roughly where the mod ends.
